390.about: design catalog Search 769 Browse 769 ABOUT · 5 SOURCES · THE LICENCES About An index of 769 components, blocks, effects and doc pages from 5 reference libraries, with the licence each source declares. One index, read three ways: this site, a CLI, an MCP server. The five sources 566 shadcn MIT · 399 items publish a source file · 167 have no captured file 110 beui MIT · 110 items publish a source file 43 transitions MIT with no-redistribution clause · 0 items publish a source file · 43 withheld · 11 have no captured file 29 rareui free-to-use (repo reports NOASSERTION) · 0 items publish a source file · 29 withheld 21 beautifului unclear · 0 items publish a source file · 21 withheld The number on the left is how many items came from that source. Counts are from the manifest, per source. What the licences allow Each source carries a code_policy and each item carries the licence string its source declares. There are two policies: full — 676 items. The licence is MIT. The source may be copied into your own repository, and the item page shows the file. 167 of these have no captured file at all, so they are entries as well. local-only — 93 items. Read the source in the original and re-implement it; it is not redistributed here. The item page keeps the name, the install command the library publishes, the facts and the licence. "Source included" is a licence label, not a file count. 676 items sit under a licence that would allow publication, 509 of the 769 publish a file, and 178 have no captured source to publish. The 93 entries without source transitions, rareui, beautifului — 93 items between them, and not one of their files is republished. Their licences are the reason, in the manifest's own words: transitions — MIT with no-redistribution clause; rareui — free-to-use (repo reports NOASSERTION); beautifului — unclear.
